method.context: Frozen sequential true-range algorithm, 14 prior valid observations. A short/incomplete scheduled session clears previous RTH context; the following complete RTH does not add a TR without a previous complete RTH. No fallback range-only TR.
method.eligibility: 390 complete RTH minutes, 09:29 boundary and prior positive ATR; compression also prior PDH/PDL; sweep also all 930 overnight minutes. No actual candidate conditions evaluated.
method.rollovers: All 13 original decisions, effective dates and joint-close spreads unchanged.
method.source_policy: Direct CME XLS cells strongest. Explicitly dated CME-labeled tables preserved by a broker are document-supported, not independently authenticated originals. Cropped attributed copies remain provisional. No product/year extrapolation.
